direction_statement: A dark editorial storefront — deep navy with a gold accent, quiet display serif, and a single curated collection framed on glass surfaces.
hero_subheadline: sdsd is a considered online storefront — a single, quiet place to discover, browse, and buy the things we make.
about: sdsd began with a simple frustration: buying the things we love online had become a chore. Endless tabs, cluttered grids, checkout flows that fight you at every step. So we built the opposite — one quiet storefront, carefully arranged, where the product is the point and everything else gets out of the way.
style: Dark monolithic editorial (S2) — parallax hero, glass cards, split-edges header, deep navy with gold accent.
